extension.summary: Bridge: apps that use CocoScrapers (Fen, Umbrella...) will use cocoesp
Puente: las apps que usan CocoScrapers (Fen, Umbrella...) usarán cocoesp
extension.description: Replaces script.module.cocoscrapers. Every "import cocoscrapers" is redirected to cocoesp, and its plugin actions and settings open cocoesp. Configure providers and the source language in cocoesp.
Sustituye a script.module.cocoscrapers. Todo "import cocoscrapers" se redirige a cocoesp, y sus acciones y ajustes abren cocoesp. Los proveedores y el idioma de las fuentes se configuran en cocoesp.

extension.news: Fix: "from cocoscrapers import sources_cocoscrapers" now works on a clean interpreter.
